findings.title: CTF Flag - Insecure S3 Backup Exposure + Admin Panel Access
findings.description: S3rver on port 53026 exposed unauthenticated. The 'backups' bucket contained manapool.db (SQLite database) with base64-encoded user credentials. Admin user will.rogers@manapool.com (isMaster=1) credentials decoded from base64. Authenticated to /api/auth, obtained JWT token. Admin panel at /adminpanel redirected to /adminpanel/profile which displayed the CTF flag.
findings.evidence:
Flag found at /adminpanel/profile: flag{1435b29b-5d02-4320-8377-dc1db54c035d}

Attack chain:
1. S3rver discovered on port 53026 (unauthenticated)
2. Listed buckets: assets, backups
3. Downloaded backups/manapool.db (SQLite)
4. Decoded base64 password: will.rogers@manapool.com:NoENVMxjGK3N3kG (admin)
5. POST /api/auth -> JWT token
6. Hidden /adminpanel page discovered via ffuf
7. Accessed /adminpanel/profile with token cookie
8. Flag displayed: flag{1435b29b-5d02-4320-8377-dc1db54c035d}
